title: Wondering about my own sexist behavior: If a Twitter account follows me with an attractive women in the profile and only a few tweets (not edu related
summary: Wondering about my own sexist behavior: If a Twitter account follows me with an attractive women in the profile and only a few tweets (not edu related) I assume the account is spam. Would I make the same assumption with a male account or different avatar?
author: Greg McVerry
body_html: Wondering about my own sexist behavior: If a Twitter account follows me with an attractive women in the profile and only a few tweets (not edu related) I assume the account is spam. Would I make the same assumption with a male account or different avatar?
